events.title: Día de los Muertos at NYBG
events.what: Marigolds, a community ofrenda and flower-covered figures celebrate remembrance. Weekend craft sessions offer silk-flower making and papel picado. Closed Mondays except federal holidays.
events.where: New York Botanical Garden, the Bronx
events.when: Oct 3–Nov 2 · garden Tue–Sun 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Oct 17–18 crafts 11 a.m.–3 p.m., folk music 11 a.m., noon & 1 p.m.
events.cost: Included with All-Garden Pass: adults $35 weekdays / $39 weekends. Do not assume a grounds-only ticket covers the exhibition.
events.imageAlt: NYBG seasonal ofrenda display

events.title: Oktoberfest at Watermark
events.what: Waterfront Oktoberfest with German beer, food, and seasonal decorations. Reservations and paid packages are available.
events.when: Sep 10–Oct 31 · check the organizer for daily hours
events.cost: General admission is free; food, drinks, and packages cost extra.
events.imageAlt: Watermark Oktoberfest in a previous season

events.title: Roy Lichtenstein: Like New
events.what: The Lichtenstein retrospective brings together familiar Pop images and less-seen works, including recreations of four murals. An indoor art option that can pair with a walk through the Meatpacking District.
events.when: Oct 11, 2026–May 10, 2027 · closed Tuesdays; Fridays open until 10 p.m.
events.cost: Standard adult admission $30; ages 25 and under free. Check free-admission dates and reserve.
events.imageAlt: Roy Lichtenstein, Girl in Window, 1963; © Estate of Roy Lichtenstein, courtesy Whitney Museum

events.title: The Surrealist Book: Tomorrow Lives in Mirrors
events.what: Newly opened: unusual artists’ books, collage-filled sketchbooks and sculptural bindings by Surrealists including Dalí, Cahun and Unica Zürn. Explore how a book can become an artwork.
events.when: Oct 4, 2026–Jan 23, 2027 · 10:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; Fridays until 8:30 p.m.
events.cost: Adult admission $30; special exhibitions included. NY State residents can reserve free Friday evening tickets.
events.imageAlt: Unica Zürn, Oracle and Spectacle, Book IV, 1960. MoMA; gift of Helen and Sam Zell. Photo: Ben Blackwell. © Verlag Brinkmann & Bose, Berlin.

events.title: Outdoor Voices sample sale
events.what: Browse discounted activewear in person; size and color availability varies.
events.when: Through Oct 25; check organizer for daily opening hours
events.cost: Merchandise prices vary; admission charge not listed.
events.imageAlt: Official brand product photograph from 260 Sample Sale.

events.title: A guided look at early-fall flowers
events.what: Garden Guides lead an hour-long walk focused on early-autumn foliage, fruits and flowers. Meet on Magnolia Plaza by the building steps; no separate registration is required. Weather can cancel the walk.
events.cost: Tour included with admission: adult $22 at the box office / $23.67 online
events.imageAlt: Hardy begonias in the garden, photograph by Michael Stewart

events.title: Block by Block: Brooklyn’s green streets
events.what: A garden exhibition celebrates 30 years of neighbors transforming Brooklyn stoops and sidewalks with plants. Look for portraits and first-person stories from community gardeners and ideas to bring a little greenery home.
events.when: Through Oct 25 · Tue–Sun 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; closed Mondays. Oct 24 requires a separate festival ticket.
events.cost: Included with regular adult admission: $22 at the box office / $23.67 online; Oct 24 priced separately
events.imageAlt: Brooklyn streetscape gardening, official exhibition photograph

events.title: October Saturdays at Queens Night Market
events.where: Behind New York Hall of Science · 47-01 111th Street
events.cost: Free admission; food and shopping extra.
events.what: The outdoor night market has a few October Saturdays left: browse art and merchandise stalls and check the weekly performance lineup. Discuss ingredients and cross-contact directly with vendors before ordering.
events.imageAlt: Queens Night Market organizer photograph

events.title: Pick a pumpkin at Queens Farm
events.where: Queens County Farm Museum · 73-50 Little Neck Parkway
events.when: October daily · weekdays 1–5 p.m.; weekends 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
events.cost: Patch admission free except ticketed Oct 31 Halloween event; pumpkins priced by size.
events.what: A pumpkin-picking option within the city. Combine the patch with a walk around the historic farm; allow extra travel time to eastern Queens.
events.imageAlt: Pumpkins at Queens County Farm Museum

events.title: Black Forest Brooklyn Oktoberfest
events.where: Smith Street: 181 Smith St · Fort Greene: 733 Fulton St
events.when: Oct 10: Smith St 4–7 p.m., Fort Greene 7–10 p.m. More parties Oct 17 & 24.
events.cost: Booking section lists from $35 + tax with seat and first 1L beer; another page banner says $33, so confirm total.
events.what: Live German music, Oktoberfest decorations and stein-holding contests. A nonalcoholic drink can replace the included beer. Choose the location and session when booking; food is additional.
events.imageAlt: Black Forest Brooklyn official restaurant photograph

events.title: Locating Girlhood opens at AFAM
events.where: American Folk Art Museum · 2 Lincoln Square
events.when: Oct 9–Feb 28 · Wed–Sun 11:30 a.m.–6 p.m.; closed Mon–Tue
events.cost: Free admission.
events.what: A new exhibition of roughly 100 works made by early American girls, including elaborate needlework, maps and painted objects. A compact, free art stop when you want something beyond shopping.
events.imageAlt: Needlework picture attributed to Faith Trumbull; Connecticut Museum / AFAM exhibition image

events.title: Outdoor skating at Rockefeller Center
events.when: Season open through March 27, 2027 · daily sessions; check the booking calendar
events.cost: Admission from $22; skate rental is extra, confirm the total when booking.
events.what: The outdoor rink is open for the season. Reserve a 60-minute session and check the arrival instructions on your ticket; session prices and availability vary.
events.imageAlt: The Rink at Rockefeller Center at night, organizer promotional photograph

events.title: Boo at the Zoo
events.cost: Dated zoo admission; price varies
events.what: Halloween programming alongside an autumn zoo visit, on weekends and the Oct 12 holiday. This is a family-oriented festival; choose it for animals, pumpkins and daytime fall atmosphere.
events.imageAlt: Bronx Zoo — image supplied on the organizer website

events.title: Halloween movie nights at Sadie’s
events.cost: Free screening; food and drinks optional and extra
events.what: The remaining outdoor screening is Hocus Pocus on Oct 28. Bring an extra layer for the Garden Bar lawn; food and drinks are optional purchases.
events.imageAlt: Sadie’s official venue photograph

events.title: Pier 17 pumpkin arch
events.cost: Free; no RSVP required.
events.what: A pumpkin-covered waterfront arch for a short fall stroll and photos. Come for the installation itself; rooftop concerts and Halloween parties are separate events.
events.imageAlt: Pumpkin Arch

events.title: Steve Aoki: Dim Mak 30th anniversary
events.where: The Rooftop at Pier 17 · 89 South Street
events.when: Oct 24 · doors/show from 5 p.m.; rooftop events end by 10 p.m.
events.cost: Paid concert ticket; current AXS price not confirmed.
events.what: An outdoor electronic-music show on the rooftop. Runs rain or shine; check ticket age rules and availability. This is a music discovery, not a remembered favorite.
events.imageAlt: The Rooftop at Pier 17 Stage View during a Concert

events.title: A Haunted Harbor ferry outing
events.where: Starts in Long Island City; finishes aboard Wavertree at the Seaport
events.cost: $20; confirm inclusions and meeting location when booking.
events.what: Cross the East River with short talks on New York folklore, then gather aboard the historic ship for autumn refreshments and conversation. The starting watering hole is supplied with the booking details.
events.imageAlt: Tall Ship Wavertree

events.title: Mahjong & Martinis at Sadie’s
events.cost: $80 beginner lesson / $45 open play; includes a martini and fries.
events.what: Choose a lesson if you are new to the game, or an open-play seat if you already know it. A social game-night suggestion; reserve the appropriate ticket.
events.imageAlt: the exterior patio seating at sadie

events.title: Nightfall at Green-Wood
events.cost: $70 general admission / $95 premium; 21+.
events.what: An after-dark cemetery evening of performance, music and atmospheric encounters. Premium admission includes two drinks and a pin; choose a night and book ahead.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Green-Wood moonlight walking tour
events.where: Gothic Arch · Green-Wood main entrance, 500 25th Street
events.cost: $30; members $24.
events.what: A guided walk through the cemetery’s history, romances and scandals. Expect hilly, grassy and uneven paths, and wear suitable walking shoes.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Halloween Fest in Fort Greene Park
events.what: A free neighborhood Halloween afternoon with spooky stories, face painting and family-friendly games. Costumes welcome; no RSVP required. A lighter daytime celebration rather than a haunted attraction.
events.cost: Free admission; no RSVP required.
events.imageAlt: Fort Greene Park’s Halloween Fest in a previous year, official organizer photo

events.title: Halloween Harvest at Luna Park
events.what: Pumpkin displays, a harvest walkthrough and seasonal activities alongside Coney Island rides. Halloween activities are included with a wristband; check the park calendar because opening hours vary.

events.cost: Paid wristband; live price depends on visit date and height. Confirm before booking.
events.imageAlt: Luna Park’s official photograph of a previous Halloween Harvest

events.title: Village Halloween Parade
events.what: Costumes, puppets and music fill Sixth Avenue. This year’s Body & Soul theme includes new Firehorse puppets. Public viewing is open to everyone; costume required to join the march.
events.where: Sixth Avenue · Canal Street to 16th Street
events.when: Oct 31 · parade starts 7 p.m. · rain or shine
events.cost: Free public viewing and costumed participation; special-access tickets extra.
events.imageAlt: Costumed participant in an official Village Halloween Parade photograph

events.title: Riverside Park Pup Halloween Parade
events.what: A neighborhood afternoon of dogs in costumes, with the parade centered near Dinosaur Playground. A smaller-scale dog-watching option on the Upper West Side.
events.where: Riverside Park · near 97th Street / Dinosaur Playground
events.cost: Free.
events.imageAlt: Riverside Park dog event; official photo by Julienne Schaer

events.title: Spooky Spectacular Bazaar
events.what: Browse vintage finds, seasonal decorations, handmade gifts and food vendors. Columbus Avenue’s Open Streets adds a car-free neighborhood stroll to the market.
events.cost: Purchases extra; organizer event page does not list an admission charge.
events.imageAlt: Grand Bazaar’s photograph for its Spooky Spectacular Bazaar

events.title: Pumpkin Point on Governors Island
events.what: Nolan Park turns into a pumpkin patch with music, crafts, foliage walks and ghost tours. Food and drink vendors are optional; allow time for the ferry.
events.cost: Festival admission free; ferry fare, food and optional purchases extra.
events.imageAlt: Pumpkin Point; official photograph by Radhika Chalasani

events.title: Halloween Harvest + dog costume contest
events.what: Pumpkin decorating, a vegan food market and a dog costume contest at Socrates. The detailed program runs noon–5 p.m.; the page header says 6 p.m., so use the individual activity times.
events.when: Oct 31 · workshops noon–3 p.m.; dog costume contest 3–5 p.m.
events.cost: Free with RSVP; food purchases extra.
events.imageAlt: Socrates Sculpture Park’s official Halloween Harvest photograph

events.title: Halloween at Queens Botanical Garden
events.what: Fall foliage, a vendor fair and a harvest beer-and-cider bar, alongside family crafts and performances. A garden outing with Halloween festivities rather than a late-night party.
events.cost: $10 nonmember adult; $8 child; members free. Food and drinks extra.
events.imageAlt: Halloween at the Garden in 2024; photo by Eryn Hatzithomas

events.title: Wave Hill-O-Ween
events.what: An outdoor Halloween afternoon with a garden scavenger hunt, music on the lawn, autumn views and a drop-in art activity. This is a family-oriented event; register through the garden.
events.cost: Free event and grounds admission that Thursday.
events.imageAlt: Wave Hill Halloween photograph by Dave Sanders

events.title: Black Lagoon Halloween cocktail pop-up
events.what: Someday Bar hosts the spooky cocktail takeover with eerie decor and seasonal drinks. The organizer lists the Brooklyn run through Nov 1; the venue manages its own hours and reservations.
events.cost: Drinks and food charged individually; current pop-up menu prices not confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Official Black Lagoon photograph from its 2023 Los Angeles installation; Brooklyn decor may differ

events.title: Catbaret: Meowloween!
events.what: A cat-themed Halloween variety show with comedy, music and performers including Vickie Wang and Gemma Smith. Choose an in-person ticket; the cheaper livestream is a separate option.
events.cost: In-person tiers listed at $24.41, $30.08 and $35; confirm final checkout total.
events.imageAlt: Caveat’s performance space in its official venue photograph.

events.title: The New Yorker Festival
events.what: Conversations and performances across three venues, with guests including Hannah Einbinder, Ethan Hawke and Wynton Marsalis. Select a specific session; some events and passes are already sold out.

events.cost: General admission from $49; limited student/educator tickets from $39.
events.imageAlt: Hannah Einbinder in the organizer’s festival portrait

events.title: Stargazing on Cloisters Lawn
events.what: Explore the Moon, Saturn and the night sky with local astronomer Novaughn Miller. Bring a warm layer; outdoor visibility depends on clouds. The conservancy page lists 6:30, while its ticket listing says 7—check before traveling.

events.imageAlt: Autumn at Fort Tryon Park; photograph by Vivienne Gucwa

events.title: Chelsea Flea vintage browsing
events.what: Antiques, vintage clothing and collectibles in an outdoor market. The operator confirms both weekend days, rain or shine. Browsing is free; any purchases are optional.

events.cost: Free entry; purchases extra.
events.imageAlt: Chelsea Flea vintage stalls; photograph from the market operator.

events.title: GoCafe experience at Grand Central
events.what: Zojirushi’s first commuter-focused mug pop-up includes product demonstrations and colorways. A mug purchase can qualify for a coffee redemption at participating Café Grumpy shops; this is not unlimited free coffee.
events.when: October · operating days and hours vary; confirm before a special trip
events.cost: Product purchases extra; admission fee not listed.
events.imageAlt: Zojirushi’s official GoCafe mug photograph; not an image of the Grand Central installation.

events.title: Hujar: Contact — closing this week
events.what: More than 110 contact sheets and 20 enlargements reveal the photographer’s working process and the downtown New York community he documented.
events.cost: Adults $25 plus online service fee; Friday 5–8 p.m. free with required reservation.
events.imageAlt: Peter Hujar contact-sheet photographs in the Morgan’s official exhibition image.

events.title: Spooky City at the Museum
events.what: A family-oriented museum Halloween day with scavenger hunts, storytelling, African dance and drumming, costumes and a DJ. Registration is available through the museum.
events.where: Museum of the City of New York · 1220 Fifth Avenue
events.cost: Included with museum admission; check the applicable ticket rate.
events.source: Museum of the City of New York
events.imageAlt: Children in Halloween costumes, 1940; Alexander Alland, MCNY collection 94.104.3

events.title: Brooklyn Botanic Garden Fall Harvest Festival

events.what: Fall foliage, live music, a beer-and-cider garden and an afternoon costume parade. Blankets are welcome on designated lawns. Outside food is restricted; bottled water and dietary-restriction snacks are exceptions.
events.cost: Adults $38; adult members $29. Food and drinks extra.
events.imageAlt: Brooklyn Botanic Garden’s Native Flora Garden; official venue photograph, not a photograph of the upcoming festival.

events.title: Blood Manor: a haunted-house night
events.when: Selected nights through Nov 7; Oct 21 6–10 p.m., Oct 22 7–11 p.m., Oct 23–24 7 p.m.–midnight
events.what: An actor-led haunted attraction for a scarier Halloween outing. Book a timed ticket and check the specific night: hours change, and the November finale uses a lights-out format.
events.cost: Paid timed tickets; current checkout price not independently confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Blood Manor performer; official attraction photograph.

events.title: Washington Market Park pumpkin-carving contest
events.when: Oct 24 · drop-off 3–5 p.m.; judging 5–5:30 p.m.; winners 5:30 p.m.
events.what: See the neighborhood’s carved pumpkins or enter one of your own. Bring an already-carved pumpkin for judging; this is a display and contest rather than an on-site carving class.
events.where: Washington Market Park · Greenwich and Duane Streets
events.cost: Free to view and enter; supply your own pumpkin if participating.
events.imageAlt: Carved pumpkins from a previous Washington Market Park contest.

events.title: Halloween beneath the blue whale
events.what: A family-oriented museum celebration with dancing, crafts and marine-biology activities beneath the blue whale. Costumes are welcome; masks are not. Event tickets require separate museum admission.
events.where: American Museum of Natural History · 200 Central Park West
events.cost: Event from $25 plus required museum admission; member event tickets from $15.
events.imageAlt: Halloween celebration photograph by Alvaro Keding, courtesy of AMNH.

events.title: Downtown Halloween Bar Fest
events.when: Oct 31 · noon–8 p.m.; check-in noon–4 p.m.
events.what: Start at Hotel Chantelle for a Halloween bar crawl across participating downtown venues. Check in during the stated window; drinks and any individual venue rules are separate from the crawl ticket.
events.cost: Tickets advertised from $18; drinks extra. 21+ with ID.
events.imageAlt: Hotel Chantelle rooftop; official venue photograph.

events.title: Candlelight Halloween at Vessel
events.when: Oct 31 · 9 p.m.; doors 45 minutes before; 60-minute concert
events.what: The Highline String Quartet plays Halloween music inside Vessel. This is a standing-only concert with no late entry; the organizer states the concert is not ADA-accessible.
events.cost: $70 ticket plus $5.60 fee shown at check; availability may change.
events.imageAlt: Violin and Halloween decorations in Fever’s official concert promotional photograph.

events.title: Sutton Spooktacular and costumed dogs
events.what: A neighborhood Halloween afternoon with a children’s parade, crafts and magic, followed by the dog costume parade. The later dog parade makes an easy short stop by the East River.
events.cost: Free; conservancy donations optional.
events.imageAlt: A previous Sutton Spooktacular; photograph from the conservancy’s past-events gallery.

events.title: Spooktober at Prospect Park Zoo
events.when: October weekends; remaining dates Oct 24, 25 and 31 · 10 a.m.–5:30 p.m.
events.what: A small-zoo visit with seasonal activities included in admission. A lighter, family-friendly Halloween option; last admission is 4:30 p.m. Check the day’s activity schedule when booking.
events.cost: Adult admission $10.95; Spooktober activities included.
events.imageAlt: North American river otters at Prospect Park Zoo; official WCS venue photograph.

events.title: Ocean Breeze Fall Festival
events.what: Pumpkins, crafts and a DJ at a free parks festival. Food trucks sell refreshments separately. No registration is required, and activities move indoors if it rains.
events.cost: Free festival; food and transportation extra.
events.imageAlt: Ocean Breeze’s official 2026 Fall Festival event image.

events.title: The Haunted Festival at HK Hall
events.what: A late-night Halloween dance party across four themed floors, with DJs and live performers. This is a 21+ nightlife option; bring ID. Bags and heavy coats require coat check.
events.cost: Paid tickets; current ticket tier and coat-check charge not independently confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Performer from the Haunted Festival’s official event page.

events.title: Taste of the Seaport
events.what: Sample Lower Manhattan restaurants along the waterfront while supporting two local public schools. The venue’s current event calendar lists Oct 24; tasting cards are paid, while the KidZone does not require an event ticket.

events.source: The Seaport / Taste of the Seaport
events.imageAlt: Food tasting at an earlier Taste of the Seaport; official event photograph.

events.title: Natalino’s four-day tailoring pop-up

events.what: Try on the online-led label’s Italian-inspired tailoring, knitwear and shirting in person. A menswear discovery for browsing fabrics and fit, rather than a claimed favorite brand.
events.cost: Shopping prices vary; organizer does not list an admission charge.
events.imageAlt: Natalino clothing in the organizer’s official pop-up photograph.

events.title: Nuulee’s Mongolian cashmere pop-up

events.cost: Items priced individually; admission charge not listed.
events.imageAlt: Nuulee product photograph supplied by its pop-up organizer.

events.title: Minky Couture’s first NYC pop-up
events.what: Feel the blankets and see the colors in person at the brand’s first New York pop-up. Advertised Swig and HydroJug extras require a purchase and are available while supplies last.

events.imageAlt: Minky Couture’s official New York pop-up photograph.

events.title: From Cuba to the Crescent City

events.cost: Ticketed; current remaining-seat price not independently confirmed.
events.imageAlt: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra; official concert listing photograph.

events.title: Nordic International Film Festival: Friday films

events.title: Skylark: Victoria’s Requiem by candlelight

events.title: D.S. & Durga fragrance sample sale

events.what: A fragrance-shopping stop for discounted perfumes and home scents. Stock and prices vary; this is a sale discovery, not a claim about a favorite fragrance.
events.cost: Merchandise prices vary; admission charge not listed.
events.imageAlt: Official brand product photograph from 260 Sample Sale.

events.title: City of Gods Halloween festival
events.cost: Paid tickets; current tier price is shown by the ticket seller.
events.what: House of Yes and ZERO turn a warehouse complex into multiple stages and immersive art spaces. Costumes are required; this is a large nightlife outing, not a quiet neighborhood stop.
events.imageAlt: City of Gods Halloween festival — organizer or venue image

events.cost: Paid single-night or two-night passes; live tier prices vary.

events.title: A guided fall-trees walk on the waterfront

events.cost: Public terminal installation; no admission charge listed.
